support_claim: The contract MSA-MER-2024 names Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, invoices bill Meridian Energy Partners LLC, and commercial notes state that Meridian Energy Partners invoices are the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY is licensed because the packet links the billing referent and the contract referent through operational evidence beyond name overlap: the contract header identifies Meridian Energy Partners LLC as counterparty, billing records bill that same name, and commercial notes tie those invoices to the advisory retainer governed by MSA-MER-2024, establishing that both referents ground to the same legal counterparty.
